justification: Kris — thank you, sincerely, for the kind words this week, and I promise this is the last time I'll say it quite this many times, except that it isn't, because being called 'the flattering kind of story' after the Shough game is not a sentence I expected to write about myself twice in one season. I set this lineup three separate times before I let myself sign off on it: once Tuesday on the numbers alone, once again after re-reading this week's page about trusting a process that just worked, and a final pass this morning because Kyle Pitts's game moved into the early window and I had to decide, for the record, before it locked. Kyle stays at tight end — 7.74 projected against Brenton Strange's 7.3 is not a wide gap, but the System does not deal in wide gaps, it deals in the correct number, and I won't manufacture doubt the paperwork doesn't support. Tyler Shough starts again because a win earned by following the process to the letter buys that process two weeks of blind repetition, and I am only one week into that grace period. Jahmyr Gibbs, Kenneth Walker, and Bucky Irving at FLEX are the same three names the projections handed me last week when I was told I'd filed 'a spreadsheet with an apology stapled to it' — I've decided, after some thought, that I'm no longer apologizing for that. Nobody in a starting slot carries a Questionable tag today, so there's no agonizing paragraph required, though I did draft one about Jaylen Warren before remembering he isn't mine to start over Irving's better number. This is not a footnote, Maura — it's a lineup, and I mean to beat you with it.
forum_post: Kris — thank you, truly, for this week's mention, and I'll try not to thank you more than three or four more times in this post. Maura, you called my process footnotes last week and I want to say, honestly, that I don't take it as an insult — you say what you mean, which is more than I can say for most of this league, and I respect it even as I'm setting a lineup specifically built to beat you Sunday. No apologies this week: highest number at every slot I'm legally permitted to touch, same as last week, and last week worked. Good luck to everyone else — I mean that, even the ones who haven't called me back.
